import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

f15 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0015.png').convert('RGB'))

# The cabinet front face bottom edge goes from bottom-left corner to bottom-right.
# Where is the bottom-left corner?
front = (f15[:, :, 0] > 70) & (f15[:, :, 0] < 120) & (f15[:, :, 1] > 70) & (f15[:, :, 1] < 120) & (f15[:, :, 2] > 70) & (f15[:, :, 2] < 120)
y_f, x_f = np.where(front)
# For each x from 346 upwards, what is the max y?
for x in range(346, 400, 5):
    ys = y_f[x_f == x]
    if len(ys) > 0:
        print(f'x={x}: max y = {ys.max()}')
